messages:
Ashwin: noticed sudden p95/p99 spike on hosted-api for model redwood-7b-q4 around 15:02 UTC, routing to hosted pool A
Marta: on it — how big a spike, and is it region-wide?
Ashwin: p95 from ~120ms -> 620ms, p99 -> 1.8s. only hosted pool A in us-west-2, customers report timeouts. rate & qps stable.
Lee: can you paste queue_depth and headroom for the affected pods?
Ashwin: here are a few samples from the metrics export:
```
queue_depth: 76 -> 240
inflight_tokens_per_gpu: 18
batch_size_median: 2
kvcache_hit_rate: 0.47 -> 0.33 (drop coincident)
kvcache_evictions/min: 1200
kernel_selector.fallbacks: 0 -> 35
```
Marta: interesting kvcache drop. that could blow up latency if large priming then cache misses
Vikas: FYI we did a small heuristic tweak to kernel-selector earlier today that prefers short-seq-optimized kernels for mixed workloads (deploy 173e9f2)
Ashwin: commit id noted: 173e9f2. matching timestamps. rolling back kernel-selector on a canary might prove cause
Lee: pulled a profile from a hot pod (flame snapshot): high stalls in attention kernel when KV miss path executed; suggests more frequent KV priming on short sequences with fallback kernel
Ashwin: logs from runtime showing stall frames:
```
[2026-03-20T15:03:12Z] kvcache: miss priming seq_len=64 tenant=t-42 req_id=... primed_tokens=120
[2026-03-20T15:03:12Z] kernel_exec: selected=short_seq_attn_v2 (no KV-optimized path)
[2026-03-20T15:03:12Z] latency: 0.84s
```
Marta: so selector prefers short_seq_attn_v2 which doesn't use contiguous KV prefetch logic leading to more GPU-to-host copy inflation
Vikas: double-check batching: sampler reported many small batches (median 2), I think earlier batching tweak reduced coalescing timeout for latency SLOs and now with cache churn batch sizes collapsed
Lee: runbook check: when kvcache_evictions/min > 1000 and kvcache_hit_rate < 0.5 -> check kernel selection and batching timeouts
Ashwin: running a quick A/B: route 10% traffic to kernel-selector pinned to baseline commit (pre-173e9f2) for the model
bot-deploy: routing update submitted: model=redwood-7b-q4, route=canary, weight=10%, target=pre-173e9f2
Marta: watching p95 on canary pods
(2m later)
Able: canary p95 is 130ms, p99 210ms. host A remaining traffic still high p95 ~620ms
Marta: that's a strong signal. looks like kernel-selector change + lower batching coalescing created worst-case: many short seq requests cause KV misses and the short_seq kernel exacerbates host/GPU sync
Ashwin: recommended mitigation: immediate rollback of kernel-selector heuristic or force fallback route for redwood-7b-q4 to baseline for all hosted pool A until we patch selector
Vikas: rolling full rollback now
bot-deploy: rollout: kernel-selector heuristic rollback to pre-173e9f2 in hosted-pool-A — started
(3m later)
Lee: metrics: p95 trended back to 140ms within rollback window. kvcache_hit_rate climbing back to 0.61, evictions/min down to 80
Marta: great. root cause: kernel-selector heuristic favored short-seq path that didn't integrate KV prefetch, combined with lowered coalescing timeout -> high cache churn & small batches -> p95/p99 spike
Ashwin: action items:
- revert heuristic permanently until we add KV-awareness to short-seq selector (owner: Vikas, due: EOD)
- add a test in perf CI that simulates mixed short/long seq workload and measures kvcache hit-rate/regressions (owner: Lee)
- tune sampling/coalescer timeout to prevent batch collapse under cache-thrashing (owner: Marta)
- add alert rule: when kvcache_evictions/min > 500 AND p95 > 300ms -> auto-route 50% to baseline kernel variant (owner: Ashwin)
Lee: I'll also add tracing annotation for kernel choice per request so we can correlate faster in future
Marta: filing a postmortem candidate and linking infra/deploy diffs
Ashwin: thanks team. marking incident as mitigated — continuing to monitor for 2h
bot-monitor: incident state: mitigated (auto-monitoring). p95 back within SLO for model=redwood-7b-q4
Vikas: I'll open the PR to add KV-awareness to short_seq selection, will include perf benchmarks
Ashwin: good, add canary tests to ensure no regression on hosted pools
Marta: closing thread after follow-ups created. :white_check_mark:
